## Quality Assessment

- [ ] Source is authoritative (government, academic, or reputable organization)
- [ ] URL is specific (not just a homepage)
- [ ] Data is current (within 2 years)
- [ ] Values are within expected ranges
- [ ] No duplicate indicators exist
- [ ] Category is appropriate
